column15: TWO DEFECTS MAKE THIS UNUSABLE AS A MAGNITUDE BENCHMARK. (1) Climate TRACE applies a SINGLE intensity of 2431 g CO2e/kWh to all 14 Pakistani coal plants, so its coal CO2 carries no plant-specific information and the comparison tests generation data only. (2) 2431 g/kWh is roughly 2.5x any coal technology's plausible intensity. Plant ratios trace_over_engine therefore range 1.51 to 9.89 without telling us which side is wrong. The validation catalog labels this row independence 'partial'; on the evidence it is 'shared-upstream' for location and uninformative for magnitude.
